title: Bluetooth and battery widgets give inconsistent info about mouse battery
line: The battery widget no longer shows made-up percentages for devices that only report a rough level, and no longer warns about them.
explanation: Devices like the reporter's Logitech M720 only tell the kernel a coarse level (Low, Normal, High...). UPower then fills Percentage with a placeholder (55% for Normal, 10% for Low) and sets BatteryLevel to that level, which upower -i prints as "(should be ignored)". Both the battery applet's own UPower code and Solid only discarded the percentage when BatteryLevel was Unknown, so the widget showed 55% and powerdevil sent "Mouse Battery Low (10%)" on every connect. Both now report the percentage as unknown (-1) whenever BatteryLevel isn't None, which the widget already shows as "Unknown" and powerdevil already skips.

commits.message:
components/batterycontrol: Don't show percentages UPower says to ignore

Devices that only report a coarse BatteryLevel get a made-up Percentage
from UPower, which marks it as "should be ignored", but the battery
applet showed it as exact. Report it as unknown unless the level is None.

BUG: 497354

upower: Treat percentages derived from a coarse battery level as unknown

Devices that only report a coarse BatteryLevel get a made-up Percentage
from UPower, which marks it as "should be ignored", but Plasma still
warned about it. Return -1 whenever BatteryLevel isn't None.

BUG: 497354

From 535f443fd278edaee3f3b149a9081871ed61af37 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:31:55 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] components/batterycontrol: Don't show percentages UPower says
 to ignore

Devices that only report a coarse BatteryLevel get a made-up Percentage
from UPower, which marks it as "should be ignored", but the battery
applet showed it as exact. Report it as unknown unless the level is None.

BUG: 497354
---
 components/batterycontrol/upowerbattery_p.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/components/batterycontrol/upowerbattery_p.cpp b/components/batterycontrol/upowerbattery_p.cpp
index ce84e17d51..7a2aa23c6b 100644
--- a/components/batterycontrol/upowerbattery_p.cpp
+++ b/components/batterycontrol/upowerbattery_p.cpp
@@ -272,7 +272,7 @@ void UPowerBattery::Properties::update(const QVariantMap &changedProperties)
 
 int UPowerBattery::Properties::chargePercent() const
 {
-    if (batteryLevel == UP_DEVICE_LEVEL_UNKNOWN) {
+    if (batteryLevel != UP_DEVICE_LEVEL_NONE) {
         return -1;
     }
     return qRound(percentage);

Subject: [PATCH] upower: Treat percentages derived from a coarse battery level
 as unknown

Devices that only report a coarse BatteryLevel get a made-up Percentage
from UPower, which marks it as "should be ignored", but Plasma still
warned about it. Return -1 whenever BatteryLevel isn't None.

BUG: 497354
---
 src/solid/devices/backends/upower/upowerbattery.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/solid/devices/backends/upower/upowerbattery.cpp b/src/solid/devices/backends/upower/upowerbattery.cpp
index dbf61c6a..c7f8aed2 100644
--- a/src/solid/devices/backends/upower/upowerbattery.cpp
+++ b/src/solid/devices/backends/upower/upowerbattery.cpp
@@ -97,7 +97,7 @@ Solid::Battery::BatteryType Battery::type() const
 int Battery::chargePercent() const
 {
     const QVariant batteryLevel = m_device.data()->prop(QStringLiteral("BatteryLevel"));
-    if (batteryLevel.isValid() && static_cast<UpDeviceLevel>(batteryLevel.toUInt()) == UP_DEVICE_LEVEL_UNKNOWN) {
+    if (batteryLevel.isValid() && static_cast<UpDeviceLevel>(batteryLevel.toUInt()) != UP_DEVICE_LEVEL_NONE) {
         return -1;
     }

media.caption: Master: a mouse with UPower BatteryLevel Normal ("55% (should be ignored)") shows as 55% in the popup
With the fix: the same mouse shows "Unknown"
Master: reconnecting the mouse at level Low pops a false "Mouse Battery Low (10% Remaining)"
With the fix: no warning on reconnect

review.text: Returning -1 whenever UPower's BatteryLevel is not UP_DEVICE_LEVEL_NONE is an unacceptable UX and API regression. UPower documents that Percentage should be ignored in favor of BatteryLevel, not treated as unknown; discarding coarse levels turns all coarse-reporting peripherals (Logitech mice/keyboards, headsets, controllers reporting Full/High/Normal/Low/Critical) into 'Unknown' in the Power & Battery widget and completely disables PowerDevil's real low/critical battery notifications for them. A Solid change breaking chargePercent() for all existing consumers without a coarse-level API should not be merged.
changes: Do not discard coarse UPower BatteryLevel values as unknown (-1) in Solid::Battery::chargePercent() or UPowerBattery::Properties::chargePercent().

Instead, expose UPower's coarse BatteryLevel (Low, Critical, Normal, High, Full) in plasma-workspace's batterycontrol and in Solid::Battery (new API) so the Power & Battery widget can display the coarse level text rather than either a bogus percentage or 'Unknown'.
Update PowerDevil to handle coarse-level batteries appropriately (warning on Low/Critical levels without citing a fake percentage, rather than suppressing low-battery warnings altogether).

Instead, expose UPower's coarse BatteryLevel (Low, Critical, Normal, High, Full) in plasma-workspace's batterycontrol and in Solid::Battery (new API) so the Power & Battery widget can display the coarse level text rather than either a bogus percentage or 'Unknown'.

reviews.text: Ignoring UPower's placeholder Percentage when BatteryLevel isn't None is correct per UPower's API and is what the reporter asked for (c8, c10, c13). The two one-line changes in batterycontrol and Solid are consistent, and the rig evidence shows 55% turning into Unknown and the false 10% warning gone. But it throws away information UPower does have: every coarse-level peripheral (many Logitech HID++ mice and keyboards) now shows a permanent "Unknown" and will never raise a low-battery warning, even when the device really reports Low or Critical. That is a functional regression maintainers are likely to push back on. GNOME, for comparison, shows the coarse level and warns from UPower's WarningLevel.
changes: Keep the coarse level instead of hiding it: have batterycontrol expose BatteryLevel so the applet shows Low/Normal/High/Full (or a matching approximate indicator) rather than "Unknown"

Keep low-battery notifications for coarse-level devices whose level is Low or Critical (e.g. based on UPower's WarningLevel or BatteryLevel, with a message that gives no percentage), so only the made-up number goes away, not the warning; this needs a matching powerdevil/Solid change
Re-verify with a coarse device at Critical/Low and at Normal: no fake percentage, correct level shown, and a warning only when the level is really low
